skill.name: tiktok-comment-insights
skill.description: Analyze TikTok comments and replies through SocialDataX to identify feedback themes, pain points, purchase concerns, and unmet needs.
skill.summary: Turn returned TikTok comments into evidence-based feedback summaries, FAQs, and action recommendations.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: One command finding is confirmed because the documented npx workflow executes an unpinned third-party package without installation confirmation. The remaining 37 alerts concern Markdown formatting, readable Chinese text, service links, content identifiers, or expected API authentication. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or system reconnaissance in the supplied files; the external package implementation was not available for review.

remediation.issue: The command examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y, allowing mutable third-party code to run with local permissions and credential access.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version and lock its dependencies. Obtain explicit user approval before installation and execution, and isolate runtime permissions and credentials.

content.user_title: Analyze TikTok Comments for Customer Insights
content.value_statement: TikTok feedback can be difficult to organize into useful research. This skill guides comment retrieval and turns returned evidence into themes, FAQs, and recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Guide TikTok comment retrieval from a post ID, post URL, short link, or share text through the SocialDataX CLI.
Retrieve replies for a specified post and top-level comment using the documented CLI or an available MCP tool.
Expand collection through page tokens, page counts, or item limits, and disclose the resulting sample coverage.
Organize returned comments into themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, FAQs, and action recommendations.
Separate visible comment quotations from interpretation and label partial results or retrieval errors.
Resume partial collection using returned continuation tokens while preserving remaining page and item limits.
limitations: Requires a SocialDataX API key and sufficient service balance; CLI execution also requires Node.js, npm, and network access.
The supplied files contain workflow instructions, not the external CLI implementation; its runtime behavior was not independently verified.
Findings cover only returned comments and replies for selected posts, not all TikTok users or platform activity.
The workflow is read-only and does not log in, publish posts, like content, submit comments, or modify accounts.

use_cases.title: Plan Creator Content
use_cases.description: Review recurring audience questions and turn supported themes into follow-up video topics.

use_cases.title: Identify Product Friction
use_cases.description: Group product complaints, unmet needs, and purchase concerns into research questions backed by returned comments.

use_cases.title: Prepare Brand FAQs
use_cases.description: Summarize common customer questions and relevant reply threads into an evidence-based FAQ draft.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize One Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the first page of comments for [TikTok post URL]. Summarize the main themes and state the sample coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Purchase Concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: For [post ID], collect at most 100 comments. Group purchase concerns and unmet needs, citing only returned comment text.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Reply Thread
prompt_templates.prompt: Retrieve replies for [post ID] and [comment ID], limited to two pages. Separate direct evidence from interpretation and draft relevant FAQs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [post URL] for [business question], using at most three pages and 200 comments. Label coverage, quote evidence, and prioritize recommendations. If retrieval fails, retain partial results and resume only with a valid continuation token within the original limits.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research with collection limits and recovery requirements

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: two comments say, 'Is this dishwasher safe?' and 'Can it go in the dishwasher?'
output: Coverage: two supplied comments only; no live retrieval is represented.
Theme: cleaning compatibility questions appear in both comments.
Recommendation: confirm the product instructions before drafting a cleaning FAQ.

output_examples.input: Illustrative sample: a partial retrieval returns one comment, 'Shipping cost is too high,' before a network error.
output: Coverage: partial results containing one comment; collection is incomplete.
Purchase concern: shipping cost, supported by the returned comment.
Interpretation: this comment alone does not establish how common the concern is.
Recovery: retain the result and error; resume only with a nonempty continuation token and remaining collection allowance.

best_practices: Start with one page and set explicit page or item limits before expanding collection.
Keep quotations separate from interpretation, and disclose post selection, retrieved coverage, and partial failures.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version with user approval; keep API key values out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating one post or a first-page sample as representative of all TikTok users.
Inventing quotations, feedback counts, product facts, or conclusions absent from returned evidence.
Using unlimited collection without a budget or restarting partial queries from the first page after an error.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a TikTok post ID, post URL, short link, or share text. Reply retrieval also requires a top-level comment ID.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY for your SocialDataX account and ensure sufficient service balance.

faq.question: Can I use this without configuring MCP?
faq.answer: Yes, if your agent can run the documented CLI. Node.js, npm, network access, and user authorization are required.

faq.question: Does it collect every comment automatically?
faq.answer: The recommended starting point is one page. Additional collection uses pagination options; --all has no default page or item cap.

faq.question: Can it publish replies or change my account?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow retrieves comments and replies only; it does not log in or modify accounts.

faq.question: What happens if collection fails partway through?
faq.answer: Keep partial results and disclose the error. Resume with a nonempty continuation token, preserving the remaining page and item limits.
